title: A bill to amend title 38, United States Code, to extend and modify certain authorities and requirements relating to the Department of Veterans Affairs, and for other purposes.

summary.headline: Law extends and changes certain Department of Veterans Affairs programs and rules that were set to expire or needed updates.
summary.what_it_does: This law amends the part of federal law that covers veterans' benefits and the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). Its title says it extends and modifies certain VA authorities and requirements. No official summary is available, so the specific programs affected are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Veterans who use VA programs covered by the extended or modified authorities may see those programs continue or change.
The VA's legal authority to run certain programs, and some rules it must follow, are extended or adjusted.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted October 6, 2023; specific effective dates for individual provisions are not stated in the available material.
